title: A baseline from CI history must not filter on a status the known-red runs never reach
rule: When a gate compares a PR with earlier runs on main (bench, size, coverage), select those runs by event and completion, not by `--status success`: a run that measures main but ends red (a metric known over budget) is still the baseline, and its artifact must be uploaded with `if: always()`. Skip runs without the artifact instead. Test the run query arguments and a red baseline report read through the same loader the CI uses, not only a hand-built history.
rationale: E9.2 (#90): `bench.mjs history` listed only successful nightly runs; every nightly was red on the known-red first scan, so the PR gate never had a baseline, fell back to the absolute budget and would have failed every benched PR. Unit tests passed because they built the history by hand.
